title: Same defect, reached through reducible noise, then automatically minimised
fact: The same header/body disagreement was submitted inside a three-step scenario carrying unused body fields and a decorative header. Automatic reduction removed the unrelated steps, the unused fields and the decorative header, while preserving the Mcp-Method mismatch.
normative_basis: MCP 2026-07-28 schema.json: HeaderMismatchError, code = -32020 — 'For HTTP, the response status code MUST be 400 Bad Request.'
interpretation: Reduction works over HTTP when reducible material exists. The constitutive header survives because header overrides are only reducible when a scenario explicitly nominates them; preserving the failure signature alone would not have been sufficient to protect it.
limitation: THIS IS A DELIBERATELY DEFECTIVE LOCAL FIXTURE. The surrounding noise is synthetic material added to demonstrate reduction; it is not something a real client would send. It proves the reducer works, not that any real implementation is defective.
